titles.title: Untitled (Ghost Ranch Patio)

description: In this sketch, a ladder sits against the covered patio of an adobe structure. A door in the adobe wall leads to a dark, unseen room. Vigas jut out from the roof of the structure.
title: Untitled (Ghost Ranch Patio)
